# Elastic and HoneyHive join forces to advance AI observability and evaluation


By


[Santosh Krishnan](https://www.elastic.co/blog/author/santosh-krishnan)


November 19, 2026

Today, we're taking a meaningful step toward helping customers build more reliable AI agents and applications. We’re excited to announce that Elastic has entered into an agreement to acquire HoneyHive, an enterprise AI observability and evaluation platform.


As AI applications evolve from generating responses to taking actions, the stakes change. Agents make chains of decisions with real consequences, and failures can be silent: a system may appear healthy even when an agent picks the wrong tool or acts on bad information. Reliable agents need more than traditional application monitoring. AI observability provides visibility into agent behavior and the ability to evaluate the quality of its decisions and outcomes.


Developers can use those insights to refine their applications in a continuous loop: observe, evaluate, improve.


HoneyHive was built to address this challenge. Its platform provides detailed tracing of complex agent workflows, alongside offline evaluation and experimentation capabilities that help developers test changes before deployment. In production, ongoing monitoring and evaluation allow teams to identify unexpected behavior and use what they've learned to improve subsequent versions of their applications. While traditional monitoring shows how your application is performing, HoneyHive reveals how your agents behave and whether they're achieving their intended outcomes.


Elastic already provides the search and analytics foundation for observability across applications and infrastructure. By bringing HoneyHive's agent-specific tracing and evaluation workflows into Elastic Observability, we aim to connect insights into agent behavior and quality with the broader operational context of the systems supporting it. This combination could also enable teams to evaluate production telemetry more broadly, helping them understand not only how their AI applications are performing, but whether their agents are achieving the intended outcomes.


We intend to continue supporting existing HoneyHive customers as we integrate the technology with Elastic's platform. We look forward to sharing more about our consolidated product roadmap in the coming months.


We've always believed that observability and evaluation are two sides of the same coin. Production traces show how agents behave, and evaluation helps us understand whether they’re doing the right thing. Understanding that behavior is fundamentally a search problem: finding the interactions and patterns that explain where agents succeed or fail. Elasticsearch’s ability to search and analyze structured and unstructured data at scale makes it a natural fit. Together, we can connect agent behavior with broader application context and turn production insights into better tests and better agents.


###### Mohak Sharma, cofounder and CEO of HoneyHive


We're eager to work alongside Mohak Sharma, Dhruv Singh, and the HoneyHive team to help enterprises build more reliable AI applications. Let’s go!
